title.purpose: Compact 24px heading, reducing to 22px at 600px and below; not a hero.

headline.purpose: 18px headings for Conversation and empty states.

detail-title.purpose: One actual PR title, 25px with 1.3 line height and 45ch maximum; 23px at 600px and below.

project-title.purpose: 16px row identity at every width, with a separate 14px PR number.

correspondence.purpose: 16px source text with preserved line breaks, 1.75 line height and 72ch maximum.

summary.purpose: 15px plain-language change explanation beneath the project name.

operational.purpose: 14px labels, dates, evidence and actor classification; context paragraphs use 1.7 line height.

action.purpose: Semibold 14px text on controls with a 44px minimum target.

quote.purpose: Exact human feedback inside its disclosure, 20px with 1.6 line height and normal weight.

components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--muted,#5b5b5b);border:1px solid var(--line,#dedede);border-radius:12px;font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}.ds-search-field{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:1;min-width:150px}.ds-search{font:inherit;font-size:15px;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#1c1c1c);padding:8px 0}.ds-search::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#5b5b5b);opacity:1}.ds-search:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#242424);outline-offset:0}.ds-key{border:1px solid var(--line,#dedede);border-radius:4px;padding:0 6px;font-family:inherit;font-size:14px}.ds-icon{display:block;width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-filter-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:14px}.ds-select{font:inherit;min-height:44px;max-width:100%;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dedede);border-radius:8px;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#1c1c1c)}.ds-select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#242424);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:1150px){.ds-filters{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.ds-search-field{min-width:240px}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-filters{padding:8px 10px}.ds-search-field{min-width:0;flex-basis:100%}.ds-key{display:none}}

components.name: Contribution row
components.description: Continuous list and 88px minimum row from site/style.css, without a glyph column. Placeholder copy demonstrates the three content areas without asserting live evidence.
components.css: .ds-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--paper,#fff);border:1px solid var(--line,#dedede);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}.ds-list li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dedede)}.ds-row{font-family:"Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;line-height:1.5;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 320px 100px;align-items:center;gap:24px;width:100%;min-height:88px;padding:16px 20px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#1c1c1c);text-align:left;font-size:14px;font-weight:400;cursor:pointer}.ds-row:hover,.ds-row[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--selected,#e9e9e9)}.ds-row:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#242424);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-content{min-width:0}.ds-project{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:650}.ds-summary{display:block;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted,#5b5b5b);margin-top:4px}.ds-evidence{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-recency{display:grid;justify-items:end;gap:6px;color:var(--muted,#5b5b5b)}@media(max-width:1150px){.ds-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 260px 90px;gap:20px}}@media(max-width:850px){.ds-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 100px;gap:8px 16px}.ds-evidence{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}.ds-recency{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:16px;gap:10px}.ds-evidence,.ds-recency{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto}.ds-recency{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-row{transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out}}

components.name: Context disclosure
components.description: Native context disclosure from site/style.css, shown expanded. Closing hides it; the app's separate Details button reopens it and manages focus. Copy is explanatory, not a CI observation.
components.html:
Contribution & CI details

Long context and initial recorded heads belong here. Refreshing discussion does not update the CI observation time.

narrative.overview:
Porcelain surfaces, graphite controls and true charcoal dark mode keep public work in focus. A short heading and freshness line lead directly to search, native filters, segmented views and ruled contribution rows. Compactness comes from removing ornamental framing and repeated explanation, not shrinking task text.

Selecting a contribution opens a separate, linear reading route: one actual PR title, concise status and observation times, then the conversation. Longer context stays in Details. Previous/next follows the filtered collection, while Back restores the user's place. Color qualifies evidence; it does not decorate the interface or invent an author task.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral porcelain and graphite, with true charcoal dark surfaces.
Search-first collection with strong segmented selection and compact ruled rows.
Separate linear reading route with conversation immediately after concise evidence.
Source-qualified signals, disclosure-based context and reversible navigation.

rules.name: The Selected Segment Rule
rules.body: A selected collection or evidence-view button uses ink on its background and paper for both its label and count; do not leave the selected count muted.

rules.name: The Reading Size Rule
rules.body: Preserve 14px operational text and 16px messages; reduce framing and repetition instead of shrinking useful content.

rules.name: The Linear Reading Rule
rules.body: Put conversation after concise evidence; move long explanation into Details instead of making readers cross a second pane.

dos: **Do** preserve neutral porcelain/graphite light mode and true charcoal dark mode.
**Do** keep selected segment labels and counts together in contrasting ink/paper roles.
**Do** retain 44px controls, 14px operational text and 16px messages.
**Do** keep Discussion and CI timestamps distinct and source-qualified.
**Do** preserve filtered navigation and return focus/scroll, with long context in Details.
donts: **Don't** restore a hero, connected attention panel, glyph column or evidence side pane.
**Don't** wrap the conversation in a large decorative reading card or repeat the PR title.
**Don't** present baseline metadata, anonymous classification or CI success as unsupported activity, humanity or approval.
**Don't** shrink task text or duplicate help to make the layout appear informative.
**Don't** treat illustrative ramps, obsolete measurements or reference components as shipped implementation.
